status: pre-download source plan, no event features or associations
purpose: Retrieve and audit only the meteorological source coverage needed to later construct a fixed initial 24-hour event window for the technically eligible historical GWIS events.

excluded_variable.name: total_precipitation
excluded_variable.reason: Blocked pending the separate accumulated-GRIB diagnostic for the 2026 pilot.

time_coverage.august: Every hourly valid time from August 1 at 00 UTC through August 31 at 23 UTC
time_coverage.september_extension: Every hourly valid time on September 1 at 00 UTC through 23 UTC
time_coverage.reason: A fixed 24-hour initial window for a late-August operational event can extend into September 1.

spatial_request.purpose: Use exactly the existing Tolima screening request extent. No municipal or event aggregation is performed in this step.

retrieval_partition.rule: Submit one raw file per year and period. The period is either all of August or September 1 only.
retrieval_partition.reason: The otherwise identical combined five-year August request was rejected by the service on 2026-09-07 for exceeding its request-size limit. No raw output was created by that rejected request.

prohibited_actions: Derive VPD, relative humidity, wind speed or event summaries during source retrieval.
Convert UTC to local time without a subsequent documented rule.
Fit a historical model or compare seasons before a human-approved research question and analysis plan.
